definitions: A situation has occurred or is about to occur that will cause serious trouble or an uproar.
Trouble has started or is imminent due to a particular action or event.
examples: When the boss finds out about the missing funds, the fat will really be in the fire.
Now that the secret is out, the fat is in the fire for sure.
If they don't deliver on time, the fat will be in the fire with the client.
lemma: the fat is in the fire
synonyms: the s**t has hit the fan
source: the fat is in the fire
